title: Personal Checking: Opening Deposit, Age and Relationship Minimums by Tier
content:
## Scope

This card lists, for every Personal Checking tier, the figures a new account is measured against when it is opened. Four figures are set per tier:

- **Opening deposit** — the smallest first deposit, in USD, that funds a new account of the tier and makes it active.
- **Youngest opening age** — the lowest age, counted in completed years as of the opening date, for a customer opening the tier as its sole owner.
- **Oldest opening age** — the highest age, again in completed years as of the opening date, for which the tier may still be opened; most tiers set no upper age.
- **Relationship floor** — the relationship balance, in USD, that the customer must already hold on the opening date. A floor of 0.00 means the tier carries no relationship requirement.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Opening deposit (USD) | Youngest age | Oldest age | Relationship floor (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 25.00 | 18 | no upper age | 0.00 |
| Student Checking | 25.00 | 17 | 24 | 0.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 50.00 | 18 | no upper age | 0.00 |
| Interest Checking | 100.00 | 18 | no upper age | 0.00 |
| Premier Checking | 100.00 | 18 | no upper age | 0.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 100.00 | 18 | no upper age | 250000.00 |

## Reading the table

- Student Checking is the only tier with both a lower and an upper age, and the only tier that can be opened at 17.
- Private Client Checking is the only tier whose relationship floor is above zero; every other tier's floor of 0.00 imposes nothing.
- The three upper tiers share the same opening deposit of 100.00 USD.

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

- A hypothetical applicant who is 24 in completed years on the opening date is within the Student Checking age span; the same applicant one day after turning 25 is above its oldest age of 24.
- A hypothetical 17-year-old falls below the youngest age of every tier except Student Checking.
